evidence: The growth rate per cycle was near the value of a monolayer. Surface roughness was obtained when the duration was longer than 20 s, whereas mirror-like morphology was obtained when the duration was shorter. The growth rate per cycle decreased with increasing evacuation duration of TMG and probably saturated above 40 s. The adsorbate formed by TMG supply might not be Ga, but Ga compounds which may be volatile and re-evaporate during the TMG evacuation.
